10C.
Public Hearing to review and consider: 1) the introduction of City Council Ordinance No. 2017-08, titled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, adopting an
amendment to Title 9 (Public Safety, Peace, and Welfare) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to add Chapter 9.27 (Deemed Approved Alcoholic Beverage Serving Establishments) for the purpose of protecting the public safety, peace, and welfare of the community by requiring all alcoholic beverage serving establishments authorized for retail sale of alcoholic beverages for on-site consumption in the City to comply with nuisance-based performance standards" and 2) other related actions and activities. CASE NO: 17-110 ZA; LOCATION: Citywide. Contact Person: Associate Planner Winter
At its meeting of June 1, 2017, the Planning Commission considered the proposed amendment to Title 9 (Public Safety, Peace, and Welfare) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to add Chapter 9.27
(Deemed Approved Alcoholic Beverage Serving Establishments) and made recommendation to the City Council to apply the Deemed Approved Ordinance to all alcoholic beverage serving establishments.
Staff supports the Planning Commission's recommendation and further recommends that the City Council:
1) Receive the report; 2) Conduct the public hearing; and 3) Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2017-08, titled "Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, adopting an amendment to Title 9 (Public Safety, Peace, and Welfare) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to add Chapter 9.27 (Deemed Approved Alcoholic Beverage Serving Establishments) for the purpose of protecting the public safety, peace, and welfare of the community by requiring all alcoholic beverage serving establishments authorized for retail sale of alcoholic beverages for on-site consumption
in the City to comply with nuisance-based performance standards" attached hereto as Attachment 1; 4) Receive the information and provide direction regarding the need for an additional Code
Enforcement Officer; and 5) Consider the Planning Commission's recommendation to increase the administrative penalty fee for a second violation and provide direction to staff.
2017-06-28 Item 10C Public Hearing to Review and Consider Ordinance No. 2017-08

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
